country_overview: Japan operates one of the most liberalised foreign-exchange regimes in the world under the Foreign Exchange and Foreign Trade Act (FEFTA). There are no general exchange controls or restrictions on current or capital account transactions for residents or non-residents.

summary.traveler: Travelers may bring in or take out unlimited amounts of foreign currency and Japanese Yen. No general currency declaration is required for normal travel amounts.
summary.business: Businesses and individuals enjoy full freedom to hold, transfer, convert and repatriate foreign currency through authorised financial institutions.

rules.bring_foreign_currency_in: Unlimited amounts of foreign currency and Japanese Yen may be brought into Japan with no general declaration requirement for travelers.
rules.take_foreign_currency_out: Unlimited amounts of foreign currency and Japanese Yen may be taken out of Japan with no general restriction or declaration requirement for travelers.
rules.cash_declaration_threshold: No mandatory currency declaration threshold applies for ordinary travelers. Large or suspicious cash movements are subject to anti-money laundering reporting requirements by financial institutions.
rules.resident_holding_rules: Japanese residents may hold and maintain foreign currency accounts freely with authorised banks and financial institutions.
rules.non_resident_rules: Non-residents may open and operate foreign currency accounts and transfer funds freely without prior approval.
rules.business_invoicing_settlement: Business transactions may be invoiced and settled in foreign currency or JPY. Cross-border payments and repatriation of funds are handled freely through authorised financial institutions.
rules.exchange_controls: Japan maintains no general exchange controls. The regime is fully liberalised for both current and capital account transactions under the Foreign Exchange and Foreign Trade Act.
rules.banking_conversion_practicality: Foreign exchange conversion and transfers are widely available through banks, licensed money exchange houses, and ATMs throughout Japan.
